papers.title: Recursive Epistemic Reconstruction
papers.current_ceiling: The bounded mechanical reconstruction claim is the ceiling; the comparative necessity/economy reading is retracted.
post_matrix_updates: The August 29 branch audit demonstrated that a stale branch would have erased the R4 retraction; the current main retraction language is load-bearing.
load_bearing_adverse: R4 falsified the comparative reading: ordered Active-VOI matches ORION on the frozen joint criterion.
The licensed-transition policy earns no economy superiority.
The costed-ordering lane is CANNOT_CHECK__CHECKER_DISAGREEMENT with 34/36 fields aligned.
No true top-tier successor was pre-authorized.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: A scientifically distinct successor should characterize the equivalence boundary with faithful Active-VOI and identify the minimal nonmyopic coupling, if any, that creates a provable separation.
papers.decisive_question: Under which transition, observation and loss conditions are recursive epistemic reconstruction and optimal Active-VOI behaviorally equivalent, and what minimal cross-step obligation yields a strict separation?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: A boundary theorem explaining when recursive reconstruction is redundant and when a precisely defined nonmyopic coupling makes it necessary.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: Prove equivalence under Markov observations, separable loss and faithful access to the same state; then construct and independently verify the smallest transition system where cross-step obligations break equivalence.
papers.population_or_universe: All finite transition systems satisfying the frozen semantic schema, with theorem-level quantification and an exhaustive minimal-counterexample layer.
papers.unit_of_analysis: A transition system, policy pair and obligation/loss structure.
design: Preserve the retraction verbatim in every reader-facing surface.
State an equivalence theorem that includes the strongest faithful Active-VOI comparator.
Enumerate finite systems in increasing size to locate the first separation witness.
Prove minimality of the witness and identify the load-bearing assumption.
Only after the theorem, design a naturalistic external instantiation under a new identity.
baselines: Recursive reconstruction with identical information and resources.
primary_endpoints: Minimum state/action/horizon size of a strict separation witness.
Regret gap and obligation violation on the witness.
negative_controls: Remove the cross-step obligation; separation must vanish.
Grant Active-VOI the same lookahead/state; straw-baseline advantage must vanish.
analysis_plan: Exact theorem and exhaustive minimality search.
No economy or superiority claim unless the comparator is resource- and information-equal.
A naturalistic follow-up cannot retroactively rescue the retracted R4 claim.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Exhaust all systems up to the first witness size and prove no smaller witness exists; theorem covers the unbounded condition class.
papers.success_gate: Equivalence is proved under the stated donor-complete assumptions and a minimal, mechanism-specific separation witness is independently certified outside those assumptions.
papers.refutation_gate: Failure to find or prove a separation supports the stronger redundancy/equivalence result; any comparator asymmetry invalidates a superiority claim.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if the faithful comparator, loss, lookahead or resource model is under-specified, or if runner/checker disagreement remains unresolved.
papers.authority_required: Machine-checkable proof and an independent enumerator; primary-source review of VOI, POMDP and epistemic-planning equivalence results.

active_lane.collision_rule: No stale branch content may replace current retraction surfaces; new work is additive and uses a new identity.

immediate_safe_actions: Add a CI guard requiring RETRACTED/R4/Active-VOI language in the live manuscript, ledger and readiness surfaces.
Create a tiny independent transition-system enumerator specification.
forbidden_actions: Do not restore the comparative necessity claim.
Do not use a weaker Active-VOI baseline.
Do not repin stale pre-retraction manuscripts.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier theory/AI paper needs a sharp equivalence/separation boundary, strongest-comparator fairness, minimal counterexamples and explicit retention of the retraction.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns reconstruction-policy equivalence; negative recovery execution belongs to ORION-06.
